kinds.d: Double-breasted white or dark cotton jacket with cloth or stud buttons, worn by cooks in professional kitchens.
Pullover top of woven or stretch fabric with short sleeves and patch pockets, worn as a medical or care uniform.
Knee-length or longer button-front coat of white or coloured cotton or polyester, worn over clothing in laboratories, clinics and workshops.

notes: Kept all three kinds at kind level as planned. Chef's jacket: dropped Hejco Kevin (minor institutional supplier, not market-covering); kept Bragard Grand Chef; cut moved to types (double-breasted, short sleeve, long sleeve, lightweight). Scrub top: added V-neck/mock wrap/crew neck/print as types; recorded the three market-covering brands (FIGS, Cherokee, Grey's Anatomy by Barco) as ranges rather than models since none is a single SKU; scrub trousers remain a type of Work trousers on the Heritage workwear shelf. Lab coat: no models per brief; length and resistance variants moved to types; trimmed the old definition to under 25 words. No archetypes, new kinds or brand-register entries added; old source URLs retained.
